Definition: from G2596 and G3650; on the whole, i.e. entirely:--at all.
BiblicalUsage: Katholou means on the whole, entirely, and here it means at all. Acts 4:18 shows the council commanding Peter and John not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the world's at all is no match for the name they were told never to speak.
